guidance.section: Versioning Spread-In Properties with Augment Decorators
guidance.excerpt: When you spread a model into a resource (e.g. `...ManagedServiceIdentityProperty`), its properties are introduced into all API versions. To introduce a spread-in property in a specific version, you must use the augment decorator (`@@added`), because you cannot attach an inline `@added` decorator to a member that comes from a spread.
Use `@madeOptional(Versions.version)` to make a property optional starting in that version.
